program:
app "Eating out" food ocean
table meal_out what text, amount money
state m date = today
let spent = sum(meal_out.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 15000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
"Last month" sum(meal_out.amount prev month) faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
form meal_out
list meal_out month of m by day
describe:
Eating out, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- meal out: what: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 15000.
Works out:

Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Last month", the total amount of meal out last month.
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- a form to add a meal out.
- a list of meal out in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
